ns0:svg.ns0:desc: A supplied ventricular-shaped piecewise-linear pulse is delayed by x divided by 0.4 mm/ms. Positions zero, twenty and forty mm begin at zero, fifty and one hundred ms. This demonstrates time delay, not ion-channel kinetics; the color field is membrane voltage, not an ECG or blood oxygenation.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Voltage traces and space-time propagation
